intent.value: Reads one decoded log line and answers with the narration it carries, or with nothing at all. The schema check is deliberately minimal and deliberately total: the type, a movement worth showing, a phase studi0 knows, an optional why, and a list of subject ids. Anything else — a missing field, a wrong shape, an unlisted phase — is refused whole rather than patched into something renderable, because a repaired narration would be studi0's account of the work rather than the agent's.

body.value:
def _reset_log(log: NarrationLog) -> None:
    """Forget everything read so far; the file is a different file."""
    log.offset = 0
    log.entries.clear()
    log.total = 0
    log.invalid = 0

intent.value: Starts a reading over from nothing, which is the only honest answer to a log that got shorter: the file was replaced or truncated, so the bytes at the old offset are not the continuation of what was already read. Splicing a new file onto an old reading would produce an account of work that never happened in that order.

Turns the complete lines of one tail into accepted narrations and refusals, in file order, keeping only the most recent window of them. Each line is decoded on its own, so undecodable bytes cost exactly the line they are in.

The narration side channel, both halves of it. Outbound: the presence marker studi0 writes into the project it is watching, which is how the authoring MCP server knows to ask an agent for narration at all and, when there is no marker, knows not to, because with no viewer there is no need for narration and no wish for it. Inbound: the append-only session log that agent writes, tailed at the watch's own cadence. Everything read here is the agent's account of its own work — self-reported, unverified, and true only in the sense that it was really written — so it is kept apart from the canonical graph at every level: its own file, its own module, its own counters, and its own block in the served document, which no renderer can mistake for build truth. Nothing is repaired and nothing is completed: a line that does not parse, or does not carry the narration schema, is counted and dropped, never guessed at.
